name: SeedLab per-step noise seed control (schedule, reseed, inject, ancestral seed, split)
plain: Wraps a stochastic KSAMPLER and replaces its noise_sampler so that call k of the noise sampler returns a fresh N(0,I) tensor drawn on CPU from a seed chosen by a rule. AncestralSeedSampler and SamplerSeedSplit give a distinct SplitMix64-derived seed per call (split switches from the structure stream to the detail stream at a call index). Surprise: SeedScheduleSampler, SeedInjectAtStepSampler and PerStepReseedSampler reuse the same seed for many calls, so the per-step noise is the identical tensor step after step (it adds up coherently instead of averaging out). Deterministic samplers without a noise_sampler argument are rejected up front; counts are per noise_sampler call, not per step.
math:
Symbols: k noise_sampler call index; s(k) seed rule; mk(s)=N(0,I) from CPU generator seeded s, shaped like the noise.
noise_k = mk(s(k)).
Schedule: s(k)=seed of latest 'step:seed' entry ≤ k, else fallback. Reseed: s(k)=D_⌊k/N⌋(seed). Inject: s(k)=inject if k=at else base.
Ancestral: s(k)=D_k(seed). Split: s(k)=D_k(structure) for k<switch, else D_{k−switch}(detail). D_j = j-th SplitMix64 output.

props.params: schedule '0:100, 10:200', fallback_seed; seed, every_n_steps 2; base_seed, inject_seed, at_step 5; ancestral_seed; structure_seed, detail_seed, switch_step 10
props.limits: only samplers whose function accepts noise_sampler
